result.summary: Found 1 issue: the bottom tab bar shows conflicting active-state cues from a stray indicator bar.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick dark horizontal bar floats between the search and bookmark icons and does not align with any single tab, while the Home icon is separately highlighted green. These conflicting active-state cues make it unclear which tab is selected and look visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar or align one indicator with the selected tab, and use a single consistent active treatment so only the current tab (Home) is emphasized.
